title: emergency.py: DoS via never-expiring rollcall entries
description: Lines 217-218: No range validation on ts and timeout_s. CBOR allows float('inf') for timeout_s or very large future ts values. Entries where `now - started > timeout_s` is always false never get pruned by _prune_expired(). Attacker can fill MAX_ROLLCALLS=256 slots with immortal entries, blocking all legitimate rollcalls until restart.
close_reason: Duplicate of vtw7. Bug already fixed - line 399 rejects infinity, line 404 validates ranges.
